Dies ist der Termin für die Vorbesprechu.en: This is the appointment for the kick-off meeting. It takes place online (the Zoom link will be announced via Moodle). The exact further scheduling (in-person and online appointments as well as the on-site block day) will be agreed in this first session in consultation with the students. The date for the excursion and workshop day in Breitenau also depends on the time availability of the external partner on site.
Dies ist der Termin für die Vorbesprechu.tr: Bu, ön görüşme randevusudur. Ön görüşme online yapılır (Zoom bağlantısı Moodle üzerinden duyurulacaktır).
